name: Evil Thoughts
overview: Scripture reveals that evil thoughts are deeply offensive to the Lord, as the wicked person's inner reflections are an abomination, contrasting with the pleasant words of the pure (Proverbs 15:26). Believers are called to exercise prudence by recognizing and avoiding evil, understanding that God will judge every secret work, whether good or evil (Proverbs 22:3; Ecclesiastes 12:14). Jesus teaches that sin begins in the heart, warning that lustful intent is equivalent to adultery, emphasizing the need for inward purity (Matthew 5:28). True devotion involves sincere, private communion with God, who sees what is hidden and will reward genuine hearts (Matthew 6:6).
